author: Esmay Rosalyne
description:
Fabulous Bodies is my third Chuck Tingle book now, and I think it’s safe to say that this mystery man has officially become an auto-buy favourite horror author for me. Nobody commits to a completely ridiculous premise quite like Tingle does, and I genuinely don’t know how his books always manage to be so horrifying […]
